description: Fixed welcome and gemstone celebrations proposed for the full companion rehearsal. Names and answers are not captured.

WELCOME.text: Hello! I'm Reachy, your exploring companion. Welcome to Echo Island!

NAME.text: What would you like me to call you? You can skip this if you prefer.

NAME_ACK.text: It's lovely to meet you. Let's head to the Forest Library and meet Elara!

LIBRARY_SUCCESS.text: You found the emerald! Great teamwork. That's our first precious gem for the cave door!

WORKSHOP_SUCCESS.text: You fixed Milo's clock and found the ruby! Two precious gems collected. Let's take them to the cave when we have all four.

MARKET_SUCCESS.text: The parcel reached the riverside cottage! You earned the sapphire. That's three gems. The ancient temple holds the last one.

TEMPLE_SUCCESS.text: You opened the altar and found the amethyst! All four gems are ours. Let's put them into the sealed cave door.
